title: Inflation just broke the RBI's 6% ceiling. What the 2–6% band means, and why December matters
short: Inflation broke the RBI's 6% ceiling. What happens next
dek: October CPI hit 6.09%, above the upper end of the RBI's tolerance band for the first time in the new series. How the band works, when the RBI would officially 'fail', and why a second rate hike on 4 December looks likely.
card: Inflation hit 6.09% in October, above the RBI's 6% limit. The rules, the 'failure' test, and the December hike odds.
